text:
emma (partnerships): Heads-up — AWS partner asked for help defining launch pricing for our private offer + joint promotional credits. Need to lock price bands, committed spend tiers, and renewal protections today. Thoughts?
raj (sales): Are they asking for upfront commit discounts or usage-tier rebates?
jess (hw-partner): They want both: a commit bucket for 12 months with 3 tranches, plus a small per-month usage rebate once >X tokens. Also requested a 6-month renewal protection (no price increase >5%).
li (finance): We can do tranches but need clear SKU mapping and breakage assumptions. Propose: 0-250k tokens => 10% discount, 250k-1M => 18%, >1M => 25% for the private offer. Rebate: 3% monthly credit above 80% utilization of committed throughput.
maria (legal): Also need minimum notice windows and an escrow for promotional credits so partner can't double-dip on marketplace coupons + private credits. Suggest language: "Promotional credits issued by Partner are non-stackable with Redwood marketplace coupons for same invoice period."
oliver (product): Operationally, we need to ensure model pinning across tiers. If they pin to a quantized variant for cost, we must surface fallbacks in the private-offer UI. Otherwise latency/regression complaints.
emma (partnerships): Good flags. Can we sketch the offer table we present to them? I'll share with partner ops.
raj (sales): Draft offer table (simple):
```
SKU | Commit USD/mo | Term | Discount | Renewal protection
R-BASE-1 | $20k | 12 mo | 10% | CPI cap 5% first renewal
R-BASE-2 | $50k | 12 mo | 18% | CPI cap 5% first renewal
R-BASE-3 | $120k | 12 mo | 25% | CPI cap 5% first renewal
```
li (finance): Add a column for "effective $/1M tokens" based on expected token mix. Also, define a credit cliff for unused commit or convert to roll-over credits with 6mo expiry.
jess (hw-partner): For the hardware co-sell, we need an early-adopter extra 5% credit for the first 3 months if customer signs both hardware + Redwood commit. Can that be a partner-funded rebate?
maria (legal): Partner-funded rebates must be defined as payable to customer and tracked separately in the contract. We'll need a simple schedule: invoice -> rebate claim within 45 days -> partner wires. Also require audit rights for 12 months.
oliver (product): Implementation note: marketplace private offers support a "partner_rebate_code" field. We should keep it distinct from Redwood promo codes to avoid stacking. ops can validate at billing time.
marketplace-bot: New marketplace draft created: https://marketplace.internal/drafts/PO-1744444444 (view-only).
emma (partnerships): Perfect. Action items: 1) li, finalize effective $/1M tokens and roll-over policy. 2) maria, draft short clause for non-stacking + audit + rebate flow. 3) oliver, add partner_rebate_code flag to private-offer JSON and ensure UI shows pinned model options. 4) raj/jess, share draft with partner by EOD.
li (finance): I'll push numbers in 2 hours and include sensitivity for token mix (chat vs embedding).
maria (legal): Will draft and drop here in 3 hrs. Keep it narrow — partner contract exhibit + marketplace TOS amend.
raj (sales): I'll schedule a 30m sync with partner at 5pm PT to walk through the table.
emma (partnerships): Thanks everyone. If partner pushes for stacking promo + private credits, we say no — can offer a transitional 'double-credit' pilot but must be partner-paid and timeboxed. :handshake: 
jess (hw-partner): Understood. Sharing with our finance lead now. Appreciate the fast turn.
emma (partnerships): Closing thread once docs are uploaded.
